result.question: How has Nvidia's net income evolved over its last three fiscal years?
result.answer:
Nvidia's net income has grown dramatically over its last three fiscal years, more than quadrupling from FY 2024 to FY 2026:

- **FY 2024** (period ending January 28, 2024): **$29,760 million** (~$29.8 billion) [xbrl:0001045810-26-000021:us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss:2024-01-28]
- **FY 2025** (period ending January 26, 2025): **$72,880 million** (~$72.9 billion) [xbrl:0001045810-26-000021:us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss:2025-01-26]
- **FY 2026** (period ending January 25, 2026): **$120,067 million** (~$120.1 billion) [xbrl:0001045810-26-000021:us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss:2026-01-25]

Net income rose approximately 145% from FY 2024 to FY 2025, and then grew another roughly 65% from FY 2025 to FY 2026. All three figures were reported in Nvidia's 10-K filing (0001045810-26-000021).
